title: Asia Pacific Senior Finance Analyst
jobDescription: This role sits at the intersection of people analytics and AI-enabled workflow automation, while also supporting selected strategic People initiatives across BCG’s Asia Pacific region. You will own core regional people reporting and analytics, while working closely with your manager on high-priority initiatives such as People Survey transformation, AP AI Boost Project, Talent 2030 and more. You will own defined analyses and project workstreams—from structuring the problem and conducting analysis to synthesizing insights and preparing materials for senior stakeholders. People Analytics and Reporting. Own the end-to-end delivery of monthly capacity and attrition analyses, from processing source data to identifying key trends, surfacing discrepancies against the global dashboard, investigating underlying drivers, and aligning on the appropriate approach to resolution. Coordinate inputs across AP people teams, manage release timelines, and ensure the monthly reporting is delivered accurately and on schedule. Proactively translate analysis into clear insights and potential next steps, aligning with senior stakeholders where appropriate. Work closely with your manager to shape the design and execution of AP’s new People Survey analytics approach under the updated global survey tools, including identifying opportunities to enhance analysis and reporting with AI. Develop targeted data cuts, trend views and follow-up analyses to uncover underlying drivers and support interpretation and communication of People Survey results in AP. Coordinate with the Global People Team on survey administration; Manage analytical requests from AP systems as part of the survey process (scope may evolve as new tools are rolled out). Planning Cycle Support. Act as Po C for People Function post planning process, obtaining plan data from Finance and coordinating across People and Finance stakeholders on data requests and validation. Analyze how capacity and workforce composition evolve across the planning cycle, highlighting key movements and implications for the AP People function. Other Regular/ad-hoc Reporting. With oversight from your manager, prepare senior-ready materials on attrition, recruiting and capacity for leadership discussions, and respond to follow-up questions through targeted analysis. AI Workflow and Automation. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting workflows, including automating recurring reports and dashboards developed in collaboration with your manager. Proactively identify opportunities to simplify and automate recurring AP People function processes; propose and execute improvements under the guidance of your manager. Document and share your approaches with the AP People team and regional office colleagues, enabling broader adoption and continuous improvement. Strategic People Projects Support. Provide analytical and project support across strategic regional People initiatives, including REACHES (AP HR transformation), AI Boost Talent Pillar (AP program to accelerate AI upskilling), Talent 2030, Strategic Workforce planning, as well as other projects that emerge over time. Own defined analyses or project workstreams with oversight from your manager, from structuring the question and developing the approach to synthesizing findings into clear, senior-ready outputs. Reporting Operations and Data Quality. Maintain clear documentation of data sources, definitions, methodologies and reporting processes to ensure continuity, consistency and transparency across People Analytics. Proactively identify and resolve data discrepancies, working with source teams to investigate root causes and implement sustainable solutions. Proactively engage with BCG’s global analytics team to stay current on available tools, reporting standards and best practices, while surfacing AP-specific needs and perspectives. Build working relationships with people analytics peers in EMESA and NAMR to share approaches and align on common methodologies where relevant. Maintain strong relationship with BCG’s system HR teams, particularly in the context of people survey coordination and AP data analysis requests. Bachelor degree in Business, Computer Science, Statistics, Human Resources, or related disciplines combined with 4 to 6 years working experience; Previous experience in consulting, analytics, or other structured problem-solving environment is a strong plus. Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude Code) alongside Python and Power Automate to build, maintain and improve automated reporting workflows. Familiarity with HR data and Workday is a plus. Strong analytical acumen and rigor about data accuracy, with a habit of cross-checking and triangulating figures before releasing outputs to stakeholders. Strong creative problem solving with ability to craft tailored solutions to meet the wide range of business needs. Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail; able to manage multiple workstreams, meet deadlines and flag issues proactively. Comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-moving environment with direction from a senior manager. You will report into the Asia Pacific (AP) Consulting (CT) Performance & Change Senior Manager and be part of the AP People Team. You will work closely with your manager on a day-to-day basis. You will also work directly on requests from senior People function leaders including the AP Consulting People Team Executive Director, the AP CHRO and AP People Chair. Beyond this, you will interact with peers across the AP People function (recruiting, career development & staffing, Teaming, etc.),

title: Global Finance Manager
jobDescription:
We enable consistent and transparent allocation of costs across the firm, to facilitate better decision-making and financial clarity. Working closely with both global and regional stakeholders, we align on methodologies, deliver insight through planning and actuals, and continuously enhance policies, processes, and systems. You will manage the oversight and continuous improvement of BCG’s global cost sharing mechanisms, including allocations and internal local cost sharing (ILCS). This role sits at the center of a complex, global finance landscape
- ensuring transparency, consistency, and alignment. Own end-to-end delivery of global cost sharing processes across both planning and actuals. Lead rate setting and allocation methodologies, working closely with regional and global stakeholders to ensure fairness and alignment. Drive actuals reporting and variance analysis, translating outputs into clear business insights. Partner with finance teams across regions, functions, and systems to align assumptions, resolve issues, and improve outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on cost allocation impacts and financial performance. Maintain and evolve cost sharing policies, ensuring they remain fit-for-purpose and clearly understood. Oversee and enhance BCG’s cost sharing systems and mechanisms, ensuring accuracy, scalability, and control. Identify and drive automation, simplification, and process improvements across the cost sharing landscape. Lead communication of policies, updates, and changes to a global audience. Finance and technical expertise. Strong foundation across accounting, FP&A, and management reporting. Advanced Excel skills with experience handling large, complex datasets and building scalable models. Experience with financial systems/tools (e.g., SAP, Hyperion, Tableau, Alteryx) is a plus. Analytical capability and attention to detail. Strong critical thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions and generate insights. Willingness to roll up your sleeves—this role includes hands-on, executional work. Confidence to engage with and influence senior stakeholders. Drive and mindset. Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership. Focused on continuous improvement and finding ways to simplify and add value. 7+ years of relevant finance experience. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or similar (MBA preferred). You will be part of the Global Capabilities & Projects (GCP) organization, working within a global network of teams that support BCG’s strategic, operational, and financial priorities. In this role, you will partner closely with colleagues across Global Finance, including Accounting, FP&A, Intercompany and Financial Systems, as well as regional and local finance teams across all markets. You will also work with teams responsible for reporting, investments, and core finance operations to ensure alignment on cost sharing outcomes. Day-to-day, you will collaborate with stakeholders across regions, building strong relationships to align on methodologies, resolve issues, and deliver consistent, high-quality financial outcomes across the firm. GS Functional Finance teams. Operating in a complex, fast-paced environment. Managing multiple priorities and stakeholders, flexing quickly as business needs evolve. Planning and delivering against tight timelines with a focus on outcomes. Analytical thinking and problem solving. Breaking down complex issues into structured, actionable components. Balancing detailed analysis with big-picture thinking. Applying sound business judgement to drive practical, firm-wide outcomes. Stakeholder management and communication. Building strong relationships across finance and the broader organization. Influencing decisions and acting as a trusted partner through a consultative approach. Taking accountability for end-to-end delivery. Working effectively across teams and geographies to align and deliver results. Contributing to a collaborative, solutions-oriented team environment. Work, management, organization and planning. Work to tight schedules but flex accordingly as business requirements change your priorities. Strong technical capabilities to manage large and complex datasets with multiple inputs in a matrix environment, whilst providing high level analytics to tell the overarching story. Problem solving, analytical skills and decision making. Demonstrate both strong detailed analytics and big picture capabilities in problem solving approaches. Ability to frame issues in a structured way at a conceptual level and resolve complex issues/problems in a practical way. Apply strong business skills and business judgement, appreciating competing priorities to drive the right outcomes for the firm. Communication, interpersonal and collaboration skills. Demonstrates strong communication skills to discuss compensation: oral, written and active listening. Build strong networks within and across finance and the wider BCG community. Ability to engage and influence, establish, and maintain effective working relationships within all levels with a consultative approach to problem solving, acting as SME in providing deep analysis and offering viable solutions. Financial expertise. You bring strong capabilities across accounting, FP&A, and management reporting, with the ability to act as a subject matter expert on cost sharing and its broader business impact. You proactively build understanding of the business to provide relevant, insight-driven support. Key Responsibilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. YOU’RE GOOD AT.

title: Finance Analyst - Global RTR process
jobDescription: As a part of the Global Finance & Operations Services team, you will support and deliver on day-to-day activities in the Record-to-Report (RTR) function including finance & accounting management process of collecting, processing, consolidating, closing and reporting on relevant, timely and accurate information used to provide financial, strategic and operational feedback which aids in decision making process. You should have experience in financial accounting and reporting, revenue accounting. Your key stakeholders will include various internal BCG functions and the local finance teams located in multiple geographies. Master accounting principles and financial systems, manage data flow, consolidation processes, and system hierarchies. Support Financial statement and related schedule preparation for Indian Legal entity. Support Indirect tax activities. Execute monthly accounting tasks, including revenue and expense recording, ledger management, accruals, and journal entries, ensuring compliance with relevant standards. Review and reconcile financial statements, focusing on consolidation, accruals, and variance analysis. Reconcile balance sheet and expense accounts according to BCG policies. Collaborate with IT and finance teams to resolve month-end system issues. Maintain strong internal controls and support the development of accounting procedures. Work independently, handle ad hoc requests, and contribute to key projects. Assist the team in developing and documenting accounting procedures to ensure a seamless monthly, quarterly, and annual close process. Actively participate in organization-wide projects and initiatives, contributing effectively to their success. Bachelor’s / master’s degree in accounting or finance or CA, with experience and strong interest in accounting concepts. 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial accounting and reporting, fixed assets and lease accounting, accrual/prepaid accounting and reconciliations, month end/year end close, accounting systems and procedures, consolidation of financials, audit controls and governance etc. Must be able to perform successfully in a fast-paced, intellectually intense, service-oriented environment and to interpret rules and guidelines flexibly to enhance the business and in keeping with BCG’s values and culture. Willingness to provide a wide range of financial services from routine tasks to intricate financial management data. Oracle experience a plus (GL, Fixed Assets and AP), Hyperion, SAP Business Objects, MS Access and other comparable ERP systems experience preferred. MS Excel, Power Point, Word proficiency and adaptable to different software applications. Advanced Excel skills and/or experience with other analytical tools (such as Tableau, Alteryx, etc.) It provides a foundation to ensuring smooth finance operations, coordinating change and ensuring performance of individual processes with high service levels. Proficiency in Excel, including complex spreadsheet and database management. Ability to analyze and synthesize data from multiple perspectives. Comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful in cross-validating results. Strong judgment, initiative, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Flexible and detail-oriented, with a focus on continuous improvement. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, effective in both independent and team settings. Proven ability to prioritize and perform under pressure. Experience in matrix-structured organizations and driving process improvements.

title: Senior Creative (Hybrid)
jobDescription: As a Creative Hybrid (Storyteller) Senior Creative at BCG Design Studios, you work at the heart of the creative team, alongside directors, designers, consultants, and clients to shape the ideas that make the work matter. You work across creative projects from strategic platform to final execution, moving fluently between the big narrative idea and the precise, considered word. You know the frameworks: strategic narrative, brand architecture, data storytelling, verbal identity. You work directly with clients and BCG case teams as a creative and strategic partner. You work across creative projects end-to-end, pulling together design, strategy, and story. The writing is your strength. Contribute to creative projects end-to-end, from first brief to final delivery, supporting the narrative architecture that holds the work together across every discipline and touchpoint. Write the things that set the tone for everything else: brand manifestos, campaign platforms, messaging frameworks, verbal identity systems, narrative strategies. Work with AI as a skilled collaborator. Use it to pressure-test structure, explore ideas, and accelerate production. Contribute to client-facing narrative work with confidence. Participate in workshops, support story-shaping sessions, present creative recommendations, and help clients understand both the story and the reasoning behind it. Contribute to the narrative standard across the studio. Share your thinking, offer feedback where it’s useful, and help designers, strategists, and producers understand what strong storytelling looks like. Stay ahead of where narrative, brand, and communication are going. A degree in journalism, communications, creative writing, advertising, English, or a related field. 4 to 7 years working in a creative agency, brand consultancy, in-house studio, or professional services environment, with a portfolio that shows narrative range, strategic depth, and genuine craft. Demonstrated ability to execute creative projects end-to-end: the brief, the concept, and the delivery, with growing confidence in client relationships and cross-disciplinary collaboration. Experience working with clients and stakeholders: contributing to workshops, supporting the presentation of recommendations, and executing against creative direction. Familiarity with data storytelling and the ability to translate complex research, insight, and quantitative thinking into clear, compelling human narrative. A clear point of view on where AI tools are useful in a creative process and where human authorship and judgment are irreplaceable. Excellent English language skills; additional languages are an advantage and may be particularly valued in certain locations. As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. YOU’RE GOOD AT. Knowing when a brief needs a different question. Leading a creative project across disciplines without losing the narrative thread. Using AI to explore, draft, and pressure-test while keeping the voice unmistakably human.

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with all levels of staff. Excellent organizational skills, ability to set priorities, attention to details and is tenacious with follow-ups. Convey a strong positive personal and professional image with excellent standards of professional behavior and ethics. Team player, highly motivated, energetic, resourceful, and friendly. Service-oriented, flexible and able to work under pressure. Demonstrates accountability and ownership. Reliable, timely and flexible. Anticipates the needs of others and demonstrates service orientation (proactive). Demonstrates a concise and effective style in oral and written communication. Effective in time management.

title: Senior Creative (Hybrid) - AI Technologist
jobDescription: You are the person who hears an ambitious idea and immediately starts thinking about how to build it. As a Creative Hybrid (Creative AI Technologist) at BCG Design Studios, you sit at the heart of the creative team, working with directors, designers, and strategists to apply technology in ways that change what the work can be. You are driven by creative curiosity, thrive on collaboration, and are tuned into what is happening at the edges of technology, brand, and culture. You proactively explore, test, and master emerging technologies, from generative AI and creative coding frameworks to AR/VR and physical computing, and share what you discover to raise the bar for everyone around you. You also work directly with clients and BCG case teams. Build and manage end-to-end creative pipelines, not single artefacts, using prompt chains, agentic workflows, and node-based systems to generate high-fidelity, on-brand creative at scale. Design AI-enabled systems where the output improves with every run. That means defining evaluation criteria, building quality gates, and creating feedback loops between what gets made and what actually works. Audit and redesign creative workflows end-to-end, finding the places where a well-built system saves hours of manual work without sacrificing craft. Translate creative and strategic briefs into working prototypes, whether that is a real-time 3D visualization, a prompt-driven generative tool for designers, an interactive brand experience, or something that did not exist as a category until you built it. Bring new capabilities into the studio before anyone asks for them. You evaluate models, APIs, and platforms, form a view on what matters, and build the proof of concept that makes the case. Support live project teams on technically complex client work, developing bespoke digital solutions and AI-powered tools in direct response to what the brief demands. Communicate complex ideas clearly and with enthusiasm, to creative directors, to clients, to a room full of people who have never touched a model. A degree in Computer Science, Creative Technology, Engineering, Media Arts, or a related field. 4+ years working in creative technology, digital innovation, or a hybrid role, ideally in an agency, innovation lab, or media and technology environment. Fluency in Python, Java Script, or similar, with a track record of building things from idea to working execution. Real, working experience with generative AI tools and platforms, such as Runway, Flux, Comfy UI, or similar, applied in a creative context. You understand RAG, tool use, and context windows at a working level. Experience with automation frameworks, systems integration, and the judgment to know when to build versus when to connect. An understanding of how brands work and how digital moments can create something people remember. Confidence presenting to and working with clients, and the ability to lead a session, shape a narrative, and guide a review. As part of Design Studios, you will collaborate with global designers and colleagues across BCG to bring design expertise and capabilities to clients as well as internal teams. Turning a vague brief into a working prototype before the meeting is over. Writing inventive code across the full range, from a fast vibe-coded sketch in Cursor or Claude Code to a production-grade React or Next.js application, and knowing which mode the moment calls for. Working with current frontier-model tooling across text, image, video, and audio, Claude, GPT, Gemini, Flux, Veo, Runway, Comfy UI, v0, and connecting them into systems rather than reaching for them one at a time. Building agentic workflows where models, APIs, and tools are stitched together into something that reasons, evaluates, and iterates. You are at home in node-based systems and you can explain why the architecture is clever.
